implementation: retrieve.py: exact cosine (dot product of L2-normalised vectors) in numpy; read-only stand-in for Clifton's Exp 1 wrapper
chunk_source: Exp 1 chunking.fixed_size_chunks on pr_document.build_document, pool A2000 (2,231 PRs)
document_embeddings: Exp 1 cache (embedded by Exp 1, documents without instruction), keyed by sha1(chunk text)
query_instruction: Given a question about why a change was made in a Django pull request, retrieve the pull request excerpts (description, commit messages, review comments or discussion) that state the reason
query_instruction_note: Exp 2 instruction for 'why' questions, written before any retrieval result was seen; not tuned. Exp 1 used a bug-report instruction.
